# iComply Property Services

> Stockport-based property maintenance and compliance company covering Greater Manchester and the North West of England (AOV/smoke control, vehicle barriers and fire alarms also UK mainland). Landlord certificates (EICR from £160, gas safety CP12 via Gas Safe registered engineers, fire risk assessments, PAT, EPC), electrical, fire alarms, emergency lighting, AOV/smoke vents, car park barriers, access control, CCTV, damp proofing and building works.

- Phone / WhatsApp: 07517 806082 (+44 7517 806082)
- Email: icomplypropertyservices@gmail.com
- Address: 17 Woodlands Park Road, Offerton, Stockport SK2 5DE, United Kingdom
- Hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00; same/next-day slots often available
- Website: https://icomplypropertyservices.co.uk/

Note: Gas work and CP12 certificates are carried out by Gas Safe registered engineers.
